nodes.description: IERC20 token that LPs deposit and that is bridged; its address is bound into deposit and relay hashes.
Monotonic counter used to assign unique relay IDs (numberOfRelays++).
Reserves that are unutilized and withdrawable.
Signed reserves currently utilized due to L2-L1 transfers in flight.
Reserves pre-allocated for a pending relay awaiting settlement.
True if the pool stores WETH and unwraps to ETH on finalization/withdrawal.
Pause flag gating relayDeposit and relayAndSpeedUp.
Exponential decay exchange rate accruing fees to LPs.
Timestamp of the last LP fee accrual update.
Local cache of the BridgeAdmin proposer bond percentage.
Local cache of the optimistic oracle liveness period.
Cached Store final fee for the L1 token; consumed by relay bonding math.
Cumulative undistributed LP fees, decremented as fee accrual happens.
Total bond amount held for pending relays.
Administrative contract that deployed this pool and stores global relay parameters.
Cached StoreInterface used to compute the final fee.
Cached SkinnyOptimisticOracleInterface used to propose and dispute relays.
DVM price request identifier resolved for relay validity.
Mapping from deposit hash to the stored relay data hash.
Mapping from instant relay hash to the instant relayer address.
Deploys the pool, sets token/admin/fee params and syncs UMA and admin parameters.
Liquidity provider deposits l1Token (or ETH for WETH pool) and mints LP tokens.
Burns LP tokens and returns l1Token or ETH to the caller at the current exchange rate.
Combined slow relay plus instant speed-up; pulls bond and relay amount from caller.
Disputes a pending relay via the OptimisticOracle and drops the relay record.
Creates a slow relay for an L2 deposit, pulling the total bond from the caller.
Instantly relays a pending relay amount minus fees to the l1Recipient.
Finalizes a relay after liveness, pays relayers, updates reserves and allocates LP fees.
Public nonReentrant wrapper that reconciles reserves with the token balance.
Returns the updated LP token exchange rate (nonReentrant).
Returns current liquidity utilization ratio.
Returns utilization ratio after a hypothetical relay of relayedAmount.
Returns current and post-relay utilization values.
Refreshes OptimisticOracle/Store addresses and the cached final fee from the Finder.
Refreshes proposerBondPct, optimisticOracleLiveness and identifier from the BridgeAdmin.
BridgeAdmin-only transfer of pool admin to a new address.
BridgeAdmin-only update of the LP fee decay rate.
BridgeAdmin-only pause/unpause of relay entry points.
View function returning the currently accumulated undistributed fees.
View helper returning the ancillary data for a relay price request.
Internal utilization computation that first syncs reserves.
Reconciles liquidReserves and utilizedReserves against the contract token balance.
Internal exchange rate computation updating fees and syncing reserves.
Builds UTF8 ancillary data embedding the relay hash.
Hashes deposit data, relay id, fee pct and l1Token into a relay hash.
Hashes the RelayData struct for storage in the relays mapping.
Reverts unless the stored relay hash matches the provided relay data.
Hashes deposit hash plus realized LP fee pct to identify an instant relay.
Computes time-decayed accumulated fees, capped by undistributedLpFees.
Decrements undistributedLpFees by accrued fees and updates lastLpFeeUpdate.
Increments undistributedLpFees and utilizedReserves by newly allocated fees.
Pure helper computing (percent * amount) / 1e18.
Computes the proposer bond from proposerBondPct and the relay amount.
Hashes deposit data with the l1Token address to key relay lookups.
Approves and calls the OptimisticOracle to request, propose and dispute a relay price.
Unwraps WETH and sends ETH via transfer, or sends WETH to contracts.
Payable fallback allowing the pool to receive ETH when unwrapping WETH.
Batches delegatecalls to this contract; requires msg.value == 0.
Time source: Timer in test mode, block.timestamp in BridgePoolProd.
Untrusted caller address used for LP accounting, relay identity and admin checks.
Untrusted block time used for fee accrual, liveness and settlement windows.
Untrusted transaction origin; not used for authorization in this contract.
External ERC20 safeTransferFrom pulling tokens and bond from callers.
External call wrapping ETH into WETH for the WETH pool.
External ERC20 safeTransfer paying recipients, relayers and disputers.
WETH withdraw followed by raw ETH transfer to a payable recipient.
Low-level delegatecall to self with caller-supplied calldata inside multicall.
External call into the OptimisticOracle to create and propose a price request.
External call into the OptimisticOracle disputing the freshly proposed price.
External ERC20 approval granting the OptimisticOracle spending rights.
Amount of l1Token (or ETH) deposited in addLiquidity.
Amount of LP tokens burned in removeLiquidity.
L2 deposit data struct supplied to relay functions.
Relay data struct supplied to dispute/speed-up/settle functions.
Off-chain computed realized LP fee percentage, verified by the OO.
Number of LP tokens minted in addLiquidity.
Amount of l1Token returned on removeLiquidity.
Sum of proposer bond and final fee pulled from the caller.
Computed proposer bond for the new relay.
Deposit amount minus total fees sent to the l1Recipient.
Sum of LP, slow relay and instant relay fees.
Hash keying the relays and instantRelays mappings.
Hash identifying a specific instant relay attempt.
Fee paid to the slow relayer on settlement.
Amount paid to the instant relayer or the l1Recipient at settlement.
Instant relayer address looked up from instantRelays.
Timestamp anchored to the relay's oracle price request.
New admin address passed to changeAdmin.
Hash of the relay used in ancillary data and events.
Flag choosing ETH vs ERC20 payout in removeLiquidity.
Fees accrued since the last fee update in _updateAccumulatedLpFees.
